cluster_stories.title: China's DeepSeek to raise fresh capital at $74 billion valuation ahead of onshore IPO
cluster_stories.summary: The plan comes just weeks after the ​Hangzhou-based company, which drew global attention with its low-cost AI models in 2025, raised about $7.4 billion in June at a post-money valuation of about 450 billion yuan, the people said.
